title: Verify Senior Service Advisor can see all pricing and financial data on a work order
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Senior Service Advisor role. (this role has See Financial Data ON).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Click Work Orders and open a work order.
  2. Check line prices and the work order totals.
  3. Open the Finance card and the Stats tab.
expected: All money values (line prices, totals, Finance card, Stats tab) are visible with actual amounts.
